title: Event line
description: One JSON object per line of launch/<L>/events.jsonl. Recorded hook events: SessionStart, SessionEnd, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, TaskCreated, TaskCompleted, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionDenied, PreCompact, PostCompact, Stop, WorktreeRemove; any other hook_event_name is ignored rather than recorded. Synthetic events written by fc: gate, phase, stop_block, stop_release, stall, trigger, escalation, lock_denied, boundary_denied, check_run, return, unit_merged, usage, launch_end. Detail keys allowed on a hook event: tool_name, file_path, command (first 200 characters), error, tool_error_code, permission_denial_reason, stop_reason, trigger, task_id, task_title, reason, mode, prompt (first 200 characters), transcript_path, worktree_path. Sibling file launch/<L>/hooks.log carries '<iso ts> <hook name> <message>' lines.
